verse.text: “Be strong and courageous, for you are the one who will lead these people to possess all the land I swore to their ancestors I would give them.”

reflection: Joshua didn't feel ready to fill Moses' shoes, but God didn't ask him to feel ready — just to be strong and courageous and step forward anyway. That's fatherhood most days: you won't have it all figured out, but you lead your family forward in faith, trusting God goes ahead of you just like He promised Joshua. Courage isn't the absence of fear; it's choosing to show up for your family even when you're unsure.
